$schema: single source of truth for the dev-page tool (dev-tools/client-config.html) and provision-client.ts. Both read this same file so the feature catalog and file/migration mapping never drift out of sync between the two tools. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-03-per-client-deployment-and-ai-automation-plan.md §3.5.1 #1/#3.

core.description: Always included in every generated client codebase, regardless of feature selection. Shared infrastructure every feature depends on.

erp.production.label: Production (BoM, routing, manufacturing orders)
erp.production.note: manufacturing_order (0018) references product, bill_of_materials, and location; work_order (0019) references manufacturing_order and operation (via routing, 0017) — verified via REFERENCES clauses 2026-09-05, not assumed from filenames.

erp.projects_time.label: Projects & time tracking
erp.projects_time.note: project.contact_id references the CRM contact table (design spec §8's 'contact is one record, not duplicated per module' principle), verified against migration 0020's REFERENCES clause. erp.core dependency added 2026-09-05 after the Phase 3A-4 final-review agent caught it empirically: time_entry.approval_state (0022) uses the approval_state ENUM TYPE defined in 0007/0011, which belongs to erp.core — an enum-type dependency, not a REFERENCES clause, so the original FK-only verification method for this file was structurally blind to it. erp.purchase_orders and erp.production don't need this listed explicitly since they already transitively depend on erp.core via erp.inventory, but erp.projects_time depends only on crm.contacts, so this dependency has to be explicit or provisioning a client with effort_based billing and no ERP core fails at 0022 with 'type approval_state does not exist'.

ai.tool_contract.label: AI tool contract (agent runtime)
ai.tool_contract.note: Only covers the CRM tool contract that exists today (Phase 5 scaffold). An ERP tool-contract equivalent doesn't exist yet (deployment plan §4.1.1) — add its own feature entry here once built, per §3.5.1 item 3's 'explicit declaration per new feature' decision.
